verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms the Snyk CLI can run headlessly in CI/CD pipelines (snyk-gh-3), produce test reports (snyk-gh-4, snyk-gh-5), and supports exporting issues to Jira and PR-based fix workflows (snyk-docs-6, snyk-docs-21), which covers the 'scan + file issues' arc for an agent-driven pipeline. However, there's no explicit documentation of a machine-readable (JSON/SARIF) output flag in the evidence pack, and the probe shows every scan requires prior Snyk authentication (snyk-probe-5), adding friction for a fully headless agent flow. Missing for 10: explicit CLI JSON/structured output flag evidence, confirmation of unauthenticated/token-only headless operation, and direct evidence of an agent auto-filing issues (vs. manual Jira export/PR creation).
